items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I know that the story of him, Tim Brim in New York... Freddie Kepard told me. So Freddie showed me the telegram that Tim Brim wanted him to come immediately

ctx.x: We only have another minute or so on here. I wonder if you have anything to add to what you said about Freddie Kepard. Since he's not here anymore to talk for himself, do you remember about his tone and style? Of course, we can hear it on the record, but a lot of people say he sounded much better than that, even.

But, yes, Freddie Kepard was a great outside man, we would call him. I know that the story of him, Tim Brim in New York, that the Coconut Grove had a band, a great band over there, something like 15 pieces. And he wanted, he kept hearing about this New Orleans style of music. So Freddie Kepard told me. So Freddie showed me the telegram that Tim Brim wanted him to come immediately, to join him at the Coconut Grove in New York. And Freddie was in love with Chicago. And so he went over to New York, and the story is,…
